limitations.quote: The final 0 of 0110 and the new 1 form 01
limitations.note: The patch correctly preserves `s3_d011` on invalid cycles, but also changes two post-match transitions to reuse the final zero, producing overlapping matches that the original and reference FSMs do not report.
The test exercised overlapping inputs but used a rolling-history oracle that expected the agent's new overlap behavior, so it passed despite the regression.
